_comment: Spirlog book rewards (Chimora 1.3.2, Ali): steps for the share of every kind in the game bonded (pct) and for Gleam kinds bonded (n), each taken once in the book (SpirlogRewards.gd). Items and a cosmetic title only, from the save alone (works offline). No Riftglass: the server keeps no bond record of its own and cannot check a save, so a currency reward here could be forged (security review 1.3.2).
